**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert new § 10.3).**

- **Investigation:** § 10.1 references only "any agreed transition period" (no entitlement or duration); § 10.2 covers Deliverables and Fee refunds; § 16.5 returns/destroys Confidential Information but pushes Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist, and § 15.1/15.2 contain only processing-purpose and privacy duties. Targeted searches for transition, export, extract, machine-readable, delete and destruction found nothing else responsive.
- **Conclusion:** No usable clause at either level, so a single insert after p0042 carries all six preferred elements (six months at then-current rates, 30-day return in standard machine-readable format, certified deletion after return), with the 90-day/30-day fallback offered in the comment.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the dangling § 16.5 cross-reference to a non-existent Section 11 (housekeeping).
